title: Korenblum's constant C_68, lower bound
statement: Wikstrom's moment lemma (arXiv:2607.17748, Lemma 3.1): c is admissible when a probability measure on [c^2, 1] with no atom at 1 meets two moment families with beta = 1 - 1/G. Submit c with a measure (atoms plus Lebesgue measure on [R, 1]) for one of the two envelopes G the checker knows.
submission: JSON in the format of certificate-jung.json (model two_covering_zeros_hyperbolic_jung) or certificate-c0446.json (model flux_halfdiameter); every number an exact rational string.

best_known.source: [Pin2026] Pinho, starred, on the 68a page (main 87b4ebb); unstarred 0.4263 [Wik2026]

provenance.keeper: T. Tao et al., optimization constants repository (teorth/optimizationproblems)

claimed_pending.source: https://github.com/teorth/optimizationproblems/pull/299 (Pinho, candidate, a modified lemma; not replayed)

score: a certified lower bound on the constant (exact; larger is better)
